clips.title: The story
paras: At the Deep Elem Mine, Grimson the Pale's severed head proves the Forsaken have secured its riches. Dalar Dawnweaver receives the trophy at the Sepulcher, and the mine's minerals can supply Varimathras's military campaigns.

Forsaken scouts called Darkstalkers found a strategic threat brewing in the southeastern hills. Archmage Arugal's shadowy enchantments had corrupted workers in the Deep Elem Mine and driven its overseer, Grimson the Pale, mad. From the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sent champions to kill Grimson and bring back his severed head. The trophy confirms the mine is free of rogue magic, leaving its underground wealth for Varimathras's forces.
